title: Cyrus and the Protocol
author: Astrid Blackwood
blurb: Dominic Halloran, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
